facts.evidence: Total revenue for the second quarter was $17.2 billion. (GAAP revenue level and period correct; the +1% year-over-year change is not stated.)
GAAP net income for the second quarter was $2.2 billion, with diluted earnings per share of $2.27. (Figure, period and GAAP basis correct; the -2% year-over-year change is not stated.)

Operating (non-GAAP) pre-tax income for the second quarter was $3.3 billion, with diluted earnings per share of $2.93. (Figure, period and non-GAAP basis correct; the +5% year-over-year change is not stated.)
Software revenue was $7.8 billion, up 5 percent, driven by growth in Data (up 19 percent) and Hybrid Cloud (Red Hat) (up 11 percent), while Transaction Processing declined 8 percent.

For the full year 2026, the company expects constant currency revenue growth in the range of four-to-five percent. ... At current foreign exchange rates, currency is expected to be neutral to growth for the full year.
The company expects full-year free cash flow to increase by about $1 billion year-over-year.
Free cash flow for the second quarter was $2.5 billion (non-GAAP basis and period correct; the -$0.3 billion year-over-year change is not stated).
the company returned $1.6 billion to shareholders in dividends during the period

Infrastructure revenue was $3.8 billion, down 7 percent; this included a 37 percent increase in Distributed Infrastructure and a 42 percent decrease in IBM Z. (Does not note it was the only reporting segment to decline.)

claims.claim: IBM reported second-quarter 2026 results and updated its full-year expectations.
claims.note: Release headline: 'IBM RELEASES SECOND-QUARTER RESULTS / Company provides updated full-year expectations.'

claims.claim: Total revenue for the second quarter was $17.2 billion.
claims.note: Income statement summary shows GAAP revenue of 17.2B ($17,162M).

claims.claim: GAAP net income for the second quarter was $2.2 billion.
claims.note: Summary table: GAAP net income 2.2B ($2,165M).

claims.claim: GAAP diluted earnings per share for the second quarter was $2.27.
claims.note: Continuing operations and total diluted EPS both $2.27.

claims.claim: Operating (non-GAAP) pre-tax income for the second quarter was $3.3 billion.
claims.note: Summary table and reconciliation: operating (non-GAAP) pre-tax income 3.3B ($3,290M).

claims.claim: Operating (non-GAAP) diluted earnings per share for the second quarter was $2.93.
claims.note: GAAP-to-operating reconciliation: $2.93.

claims.claim: Adjusted EBITDA for the second quarter was $4.8 billion.
claims.note: Adjusted EBITDA reconciliation: 4.8B for Q2 2026.

claims.claim: Adjusted EBITDA margin for the second quarter was 27.8%.
claims.note: Adjusted EBITDA margin 27.8 for the three months ended June 30, 2026.

claims.claim: Software revenue was $7.8 billion, up 5 percent.
claims.note: Segment results: Software revenues of $7.8 billion, up 5 percent.

claims.claim: Software growth was driven by Data and Hybrid Cloud (Red Hat).
claims.note: Characterization, but consistent with the release's line detail (Data +19%, Hybrid Cloud +11% vs Automation +4%, Transaction Processing -8%) and management commentary on Red Hat, watsonx, HashiCorp and Confluent.

claims.claim: Data revenue was up 19 percent.
claims.note: Segment results: Data up 19 percent (up 18 percent at constant currency).

claims.claim: Hybrid Cloud (Red Hat) revenue was up 11 percent.
claims.note: Segment results: Hybrid Cloud (Red Hat) up 11 percent.

claims.claim: Transaction Processing revenue declined 8 percent.
claims.note: Segment results: Transaction Processing down 8 percent.

claims.claim: Consulting revenue was $5.3 billion and was flat.
claims.note: Segment results: Consulting revenues of $5.3 billion, flat (up 1 percent at constant currency).

claims.claim: Infrastructure revenue was $3.8 billion, down 7 percent.
claims.note: Segment results: Infrastructure revenues of $3.8 billion, down 7 percent.

claims.claim: Distributed Infrastructure revenue increased 37 percent.
claims.note: Segment results: Distributed Infrastructure up 37 percent.

claims.claim: IBM Z revenue decreased 42 percent.
claims.note: Segment results: IBM Z down 42 percent.

claims.claim: Financing revenue was $0.2 billion, up 12 percent.
claims.note: Segment results: Financing revenues of $0.2 billion, up 12 percent.

claims.claim: For full-year 2026 the company expects constant currency revenue growth in the range of four-to-five percent.
claims.note: Full-year expectations: 'now expects full-year constant currency revenue growth in the range of four-to-five percent.'

claims.claim: The company expects full-year free cash flow to increase by about $1 billion year over year.
claims.note: Full-year expectations: 'continues to expect full-year free cash flow to increase by about $1 billion year-over-year.'

claims.claim: The company expects improved pre-tax income margin expansion for the full year.
claims.note: Operational focus areas: 'The company now expects improved pre-tax income margin expansion for the full year.'

claims.claim: At current foreign exchange rates, currency is expected to be neutral to growth for the full year.
claims.note: Full-year expectations bullet on revenue.

claims.claim: IBM ended the second quarter with $8.2 billion of cash, restricted cash and marketable securities.
claims.note: Cash flow and balance sheet section states $8.2 billion.

claims.claim: That cash balance was a decrease of $6.3 billion from year-end 2025.
claims.note: Release: 'down $6.3 billion from year-end 2025.'

claims.claim: Total debt was $62.0 billion at the end of the second quarter.
claims.note: Release: 'Debt ... totaled $62.0 billion.'

claims.claim: IBM Financing debt was $13.0 billion.
claims.note: Release: 'including IBM Financing debt of $13.0 billion.'

claims.claim: The company invested $10.5 billion in acquisitions during the first six months of the year.
claims.note: Release: '$10.5 billion in acquisitions this year'; cash flow statement shows $10,480M for the six months ended June 30, 2026.

claims.claim: Free cash flow for the second quarter was $2.5 billion.
claims.note: Free cash flow reconciliation: $2,540M for Q2 2026.

claims.claim: The company returned $1.6 billion to shareholders in dividends during the second quarter.
claims.note: Cash flow and balance sheet section states $1.6 billion returned in dividends in the second quarter.

claims.claim: The CFO said the company faced revenue headwinds late in the second quarter.
claims.note: Kavanaugh quote: 'Although we faced revenue headwinds late in the second quarter...'

claims.claim: IBM will invest $10 billion in quantum computing over the next five years.
claims.note: Release says 'more than $10 billion in quantum over the next five years'; the brief drops 'more than', a minor understatement of the floor.

claims.claim: IBM has a goal to deliver a large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computer by 2029.
claims.note: Release: 'remains on track to deliver the first large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computer by 2029.'

claims.claim: IBM is expanding sales coverage and deploying Forward Deployed Engineers to capture AI-driven growth opportunities.
claims.note: Operational focus areas: expanding sales coverage across thousands of additional clients and investing in specialized talent including Forward Deployed Engineers.
